stem.text: An object is moved in a vertical plane from X to Y, and then from Y to Z, as shown in the diagram.

stem.alt: Diagram of points X, Y, Z and V in a vertical plane: a vertical line from X down to Y, a horizontal line from X to V, a vertical line from V up to Z, and a diagonal line from Y to Z crossing the horizontal line at a point between X and V. Printed labels: 3 m (XY), 4 m (X to the crossing point), 4 m (crossing point to V), 3 m (VZ), and 5 m on each part of the diagonal; right-angle marks at X and V.

stem.text: The distances between various points are indicated on the diagram.
Lines XY and VZ are vertical.
How much gravitational potential energy does the object gain by moving from X to Z?
